title: AARO director says AARO works with UARCs and FFRDCs

tellings.quote: as recently as 2024, the new AROW director John Kazowski said that Arrow is working with both UARS and FFRDC's.

plain: At a US Senate hearing in 2024, Jon Kosloski, the director of AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate unexplained aerial sightings, reportedly said his office works with university-affiliated research centers and with federally funded research and development centers, outside research bodies that do contract work for the government. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb points this out, without naming a source, mentioning Senator Kirsten Gillibrand in connection with the hearing. He raises it because it would mean UFO work reaches beyond the Pentagon into universities and government-funded labs.
